Model checks

These test the models, not bets. They are scored on their own terms and ignore every filter.

Game simulationsDoes the real score land inside the simulated range?

Before each game the model plays it out thousands of times and gives a range for the final margin, the total points and each player's stats. The test: does the real result land inside the 80% range about 80% of the time? A range that is too narrow gets missed too often; one that is too wide gets hit almost every time and says little.

Advanced: do two players move together?

Props: minutes model vs simulationsIs the simple model as good as playing each game out?

The simple minutes model prices a prop as projected minutes times a per-minute rate, worked out directly (this is what Player Props uses). The test: does playing the game out 10,000 times, or only 50 times, price props any better?
